name: timer

frames.best_why: Timer reads 03.46 mid-run with the clock icon and no cursor over the readout.

tagline: A small pill counts elapsed time beside start and reset controls.
summary: A dark pill shows a clock icon and a monospaced stopwatch counting in hundredths of a second. Start, Pause and Reset buttons below drive it, and the clock spins while it runs.
appearance: A compact dark pill with a thin light border holds a small clock glyph and a monospaced time such as 03.46. Under it the demo places three rounded buttons: Start, Pause and Reset.
behaviour: Pressing Start sends the digits counting in hundredths of a second while the clock icon turns. Pause freezes the value and Reset returns it to zero, while the pill itself keeps its shape.
demo_content: Start, Pause and Reset buttons under a timer counting up from zero.
search_phrases: count up timer for a page
elapsed time pill with a clock icon
timer to measure how long a task takes
loading timer with a spinning clock
use_when: You need to show elapsed time next to start, pause and reset controls in a toolbar.
avoid_when: It only counts up, has no countdown or alarm, and zeroes whenever the loading prop flips.
customise: Variant, size, time format and reset-on-change behaviour are props; the clock icon can be swapped and the label and readout have their own subcomponents.
weight_why: One animation frame loop only while running; the spin is pure CSS.

a11y.note: It carries role timer with a polite live region, but the display grabs no focus and ignores reduced motion.

issues: The live region fires on every frame, so screen readers hear constant time updates.
polish_why: Neat, restrained pill with tabular digits; the live region fires far too often.
